title: Simple can still feel distinct.
description: Every site gets a clear visual point of view, shaped to fit the business and the people it serves.

items.name: Industrial
items.description: A rugged, modern industrial style built around strong typography, structural grids, practical layouts, and restrained safety-inspired accents.

items.name: Terra Brutal
items.description: A bold, neo-brutalist landscaping site blending earthy colors, oversized typography, hard-edged borders, and playful retro character.

items.name: Minimalist
